subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should this first dashboard-domain landing support `mcp-app` widgets now, or should it be explicitly limited to renderable HTML widgets until an authorized MCP-app view contract is designed?
rationale: The protocol currently advertises `mcp-app` widgets but does not provide clients a safe render or reconstruction path; choosing the permanent public contract is product and API direction, not a mechanical repair.

options.title: Land HTML-only dashboard widgets
options.body: Remove or reject the MCP-app variant for this landing and retain only the ticketed HTML widget path until a separate contract is approved.

options.title: Define an MCP-app view contract
options.body: Add an appropriately scoped descriptor or ticketed reconstruction path, with explicit authorization and end-to-end rendering proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Land HTML-only dashboard widgets
recommendation.body: Remove or reject the MCP-app variant for this landing and retain only the ticketed HTML widget path until a separate contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged and proposed feature history places this person closest to the board UI and server-contract boundary.
